meta.name: sprint-status
meta.description: Track parallel work sessions and prevent confusion across multiple Claude Code instances. Every major step ends with a status line. Every question re-states project, branch, and task.

copy.tagline: 跟踪并行工作会话，避免多实例混淆
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果同时运行多个 Claude Code 实例需要保持上下文清晰
copy.tagline_en: Track parallel work sessions and prevent confusion across instances
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run multiple Claude Code instances and need clear context

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在每次决策、计划或重要操作前显示会话标识（项目、分支、任务），并在每个主要步骤结束时输出状态行（完成、完成但有备注、受阻、需要信息）。
howto.when: 当检测到多个 Claude Code 会话并行运行时，每次响应都会触发；单会话时在任务边界和提供选项前触发。

say.text: 显示所有会话的当前状态。
say.note: Claude 会编译一个冲刺状态面板。

say.text: 这个步骤完成后报告状态。
say.note: Claude 会在步骤结束时输出状态行。

say.text: 我需要更多信息才能继续。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude displays a session identifier (project, branch, task) before every decision, plan, or significant action, and ends each major step with a status line (COMPLETE, COMPLETE_WITH_NOTES, BLOCKED, NEEDS_INFO).
howto.when_en: Triggered when multiple Claude Code sessions are detected running in parallel; for single sessions, triggered at task boundaries and before presenting options.

say_en.text: Show the current status of all sessions.
Report status after this step is done.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a status line at step end.

say_en.text: I need more info to proceed.
say_en.note: Claude asks with NEEDS_INFO and provides a default.
